age.high_age_policy: retain source coding flag; do not interpret 91 as a recovered true age and do not fit a separate high-age model
age.standardization: estimate mean and standard deviation within each fitting population only

temporal_assignment.boundary_policy: exclude only from strict temporal analysis and retain in other analysis queues
temporal_assignment.allocation_basis: complete containment in one phase; no midpoint allocation and no anchor_group fallback

landmark.split: t <= h is index and t > h is later; observations exactly at h belong to index
landmark.queue: construct each horizon-specific eligible queue from the same upstream base queue
landmark.assignment: preserve existing random/nested assignments for existing stays; assign newly eligible stays once by a fixed outcome-independent rule
landmark.pairing: candidate models are paired by stay_id on the same eligible assessment sample; empty windows are excluded, never scored as zero
landmark.table_7: refit population component and select penalty separately for each horizon using its corresponding fitting and tuning groups

figure_3.penalty: freeze the primary 12-hour penalty selected within the approved fitting/tuning design

landmark.count_split: explicitly separate from fixed-clock split and not used as a fallback

simulation_policy: reuse existing simulation outputs unless the shared strict-clock code audit demonstrates a dependent result; do not change mechanisms, seeds, repetitions, candidate menu, or theory targets
